one_liner: Senior supervisor at the White House Communications Agency (DISA) overseeing program analysis, acquisition, budget and personnel/admin functions through subordinate supervisors.
fit_summary: This GG-14 supervisory role needs a year at GS-13 level in program evaluation, acquisition, budget execution or administrative management, plus SCI eligibility. Daniel's resume shows support-level operations and logistics, not senior budget, acquisition or supervision, so skip it.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens); no federal status required, but it is Cyber Excepted Service and does not convert to competitive service.

Specialized experience: one year at the GG/GS-13 equivalent evaluating complex programs and resource requirements, coordinating acquisition actions, overseeing budget execution, resolving funding issues, or managing administrative processes.
No education substitution at GG-14; experience must be shown in the resume body.
Must obtain and maintain a Top Secret/SCI clearance (White House Communications Agency), which likely means an extensive background investigation.
All qualifications must be met within 30 days after the November 2, 2026 closing date.
